title: Cornucopias CopiCafe - Episode 3
description:
In this latest episode of COPICafe, Cornucopias CEOs Rob Greig and Josh Jones discuss the latest events from within the Cornucopias metaverse game. Listen to the corn-brains behind it all as they discuss Cornucopias' latest developments. This conversation includes the upcoming OG Bubblejett Sprinter Custom Mint, our land districts and utility, the updated roadmap, a special guest and, of course...a little leak!

Crack open your favorite beverage and enjoy this information-packed chat in the casual, comfy, corntastic episode of COPICafe!

0:00 - Intro
0:30 - Beverage Choices
1:23 - Upcoming Bubblejett Sprinter OG Custom Mint
2:42 - Discord Roles
5:20 - NFT Marketplace
6:00 - Land Sale / Utility
12:40 - Updated Roadmap
17:03 - Special Guest
23:10 - COPI Wiki
31:02 - Leak
32:54 - Rob Refuses to Sing

Be sure to like and subscribe to our channel for more developments from the Cornucopias metaverse project! Also, check out our social channels below:

https://linktr.ee/cornucopias.game

$COPI Token is available to purchase on https://app.minswap.org/swap.

#COPINFTSALE #BubblejettNFTs #Metaverse #MetaverseProject #Cardano #CryptoCurrency #Blockchain #NFT #MetaverseGame #CornucopiasGame #CardanoGaming #ADA
